office_does: The West District Court judge in White Salmon hears infractions, misdemeanors, civil cases up to $75,000 and small claims, and serves White Salmon and Bingen; only West District voters elect the judge.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Jeff Baker, on the West District Court bench since 2014, is the only candidate. Only voters in the West District Court district vote on this seat.

candidates.summary: West District Court judge since 2014 and a former Superior Court commissioner and Hood River lawyer; the only candidate.
highlights: Judicial representative on the statewide Trueblood implementation committee [S1]
